notes:
CRM notes:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS (guided onboarding copilots) building in-app product assistants + guided flows. Primary product: in-app copilot that sequences onboarding steps + calls out to internal tools (tool-calling).
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first to validate latency SLOs (aiming for 200-300ms tail for streaming step responses), then move to Dedicated if POC hits reliability and cost targets.
- Key ask: token cost caps per user/session and predictable per-route latency (want streaming + tool-calls without spiky token usage).
- Quote from CTO: "We need a predictable cost model — if a session can blow past token caps it kills our unit economics."
- POC success criteria: 1) median latency <150ms per token with streaming enabled for 8k context average, 2) end-to-end tool-call roundtrip <500ms, 3) per-session token cost under $0.40 on average, 4) no SSO blockers.
- Proposed POC: 4 weeks, 2 sandbox customers, sample traffic from staging, instrumentation: per-token cost, per-route tail latency, KV cache hit rates.
- Security: require SAML SSO + audit logs + optional KMS for keying. Legal asked about retention — want 90d default, options to configure.
- Pricing sensitivity: finance wants a clear transition path (hosted credits -> committed Dedicated pricing). They asked for a price ladder and a burst policy.
- Internal notes: favorable to Redwood's streaming and fallback model. Concern: Dedicated pricing needs to be competitive vs. self-hosted/other vendors.
- Next steps: set up POC onboarding call, share POC playbook & integration checklist, SE to draft latency instrumentation snippet.
